observations: Playwright's en-US locale made the page default to English; that's expected behavior (ES is fallback when browser locale is es-*). ES strings confirmed by code inspection of i18n/index.js via PricingSection + HeroSection conditional rendering.

page.route + window.location redirect causes the fetch-spy window variable to be cleared after the app redirects to the Stripe URL. Net result: Stripe-call counter reads 0 AFTER redirect but the call DID fire (confirmed in earlier Playwright run output: 'Stripe create-checkout calls from navbar: 1'). No app bug.
SENDER_EMAIL is 'no-reply@quantroos.com' as required. Welcome email is not actually sent by the tests (we never transition a tx to 'paid') — wiring verified structurally.
Language-toggle buttons in the Navbar don't have data-testid (ES/EN pills) — they use plain text. Iteration 5 already noted this; test still works via text selector.
action_items: OPTIONAL: Add data-testid='lang-toggle-es' / 'lang-toggle-en' to the Navbar locale pills to make automated i18n tests selector-stable (minor DX improvement).

OPTIONAL: Consider adding a unit test for send_welcome_email() that stubs resend.Emails.send to assert params (from/to/subject/html) without hitting the real Resend API — current tests verify module structure only.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stripe_checkout_status + stripe_webhook: welcome email fire is guarded by BOTH 'payment_status != paid' AND 'not welcome_email_sent' → double-idempotent. Good.
server.py: email persisted in metadata too — handy for Stripe dashboard correlation. Good.
emails.py: send_welcome_email uses asyncio.to_thread for the sync Resend SDK — correct non-blocking pattern in FastAPI.
emails.py: amount_usd formatted as ${:.2f} → always shows 2 decimals. Good.
PricingSection.jsx: window.location.href = 'mailto:...' is fine for Enterprise; framer-motion layoutId='billing-pill' gives the animated pill effect as required.
PricingSection.jsx: AnimatedPrice uses AnimatePresence mode='wait' keyed on value — smooth price swap. Good.
HeroSection.jsx: PDF link uses rel='noopener noreferrer' — safe target='_blank' practice.
test_credentials: Not required — STRIPE_API_KEY=sk_test_emergent + RESEND_API_KEY preconfigured in /app/backend/.env.
seed_data_creation: Two pending payment_transactions rows added via create-checkout (TEST_iter6_email@example.com and anonymous). One TEST_regress_earlyaccess@example.com early-access row. All included in the 127+ baseline count anyway.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pricing default billing is 'annual'. Data-testids to use: billing-toggle-monthly/annual, pricing-annual-badge, pricing-price-starter/pro/enterprise, pricing-tier-0/1/2, pricing-cta-0/1/2, hero-pdf-link, nav-cta, hero-headline. Browser locale drives language unless user clicks the ES/EN pills (no data-testid). Enterprise CTA is a mailto redirect; Starter/Pro CTAs call startStripeCheckout. When spying Stripe calls via window.fetch, note the app redirects to Stripe URL right after, so read the counter before navigation (or intercept the redirect with page.route+fulfill and keep same-origin).
